fields.subject: SpanParser
fields.trigger: a caller appends a supported value at a current output-buffer position
fields.response: write the value's defined UTF-8 segment representation, prepend '+' when the position is nonzero, and return the index immediately after the written segment
fields.postcondition: the returned index can be supplied to the next append so that the values remain sequentially extractable
